title: Release builds resolve Maven and npm dependencies through Chainguard Libraries; a weekly workflow reports coverage gaps

criteria.then: writes a settings.xml mirror with mirrorOf exactly central to https://libraries.cgr.dev/java/ using CHAINGUARD_JAVA_IDENTITY_ID/TOKEN, keeps the five GitHub Packages servers, and has no wildcard mirror
installs via https://libraries.cgr.dev/javascript/ with a temporary .npmrc from CHAINGUARD_JS_IDENTITY_ID/TOKEN, and no committed .npmrc carries credentials
has a workflow_dispatch skip_chainguard input (default off) that logs a warning, and neither job caches ~/.m2 or ~/.npm
runs on schedule and workflow_dispatch only, with contents: read, resolves Maven and npm ci --ignore-scripts through Chainguard, and writes a job summary
ci.yml is untouched by Chainguard and every uses: is pinned by full SHA
docs/chainguard-libraries.md exists and docs/releasing.md links to it
